subject: Pricing: carevault compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency)
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@carevault.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@carevault.com>, procurement@carevault.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing: compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and our security team asked me to pull together a formal ask so we can compare vendor economics. High level we need a clear, itemized pricing approach for:
- Audit log retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365 days), expected per-GB costs and ingestion pricing
- KMS (per-seat licensing) vs. managed HSM installation (one-time setup + recurring maintenance)
- Data residency options (US-only region vs. multi-region) and any per-region surcharge
- HIPAA activation / attestation fees (one-time vs. included)

A couple of notes from security: we will need SOC2 Type II evidence and a list of ASV/pen-test dates. Procurement: please show both amortized and upfront cost options for any one-time implementation fees as we evaluate capex vs. opex.

Can you send an itemized sheet and a recommended commercial path (pilot pricing / implementation credit / commit thresholds that unlock discounts)? Also include any DocuSign or PO instructions for faster processing.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
CareVault Health
procurement@carevault.com

Attachments: procurement_requirements.pdf (PDF)
From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@carevault.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@carevault.com>, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency)

Hi Samantha — appreciate the clear list. I attached an itemized workbook (carevault_pricing_v3.xlsx) that maps our standard add-ons and two commercial pathways: Pilot/Proof (short-term credit) and Enterprise Commit (12-month annualized discounting). Key highlights here:

- Audit logs:
  • 30d retention: $0.02/GB ingest, $0.005/GB/month storage
  • 90d retention: $0.05/GB ingest, $0.012/GB/month storage
  • 365d retention: $0.12/GB ingest, $0.03/GB/month storage
  • We can apply a 20% volume discount for >5TB/month commit

- KMS / HSM:
  • KMS-managed seats: $250/seat/month (includes key rotation SLA)
  • HSM-managed installation: one-time setup $48,000 (optional on-prem or cloud HSM), recurring maintenance $1,200/month
  • Option to amortize the one-time HSM setup over 12 months in our workbook (we show both arithmetic examples)

- Data residency:
  • US-only: no surcharge
  • Multi-region (EU/APAC): $0.06/GB additional egress + $3,000/month regional orchestration fee

- HIPAA activation:
  • One-time attestation/setup: $12,000 or waived with Enterprise Commit >= $200k ACV within 90 days

Commercial asks / questions for you: what average monthly token throughput do you expect for pilot vs. production? That drives audit log volume and whether the 5TB discount band is reachable.

We can do an implementation credit of up to $25k for pilots if you sign a 6–12 week evaluation SOW. If procurement prefers amortization, we can amortize HSM setup over 12 months by default — happy to model 6 months as well if you'd prefer a faster payback.

Next steps: I can hold a short call with Tom + your security lead to walk through the SOC2 evidence and HSM deployment model.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: carevault_pricing_v3.xlsx (Excel)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing: carevault compliance add-ons — commercial suggestion

Lauren / Aditya — forwarding Samantha's ask and your initial workbook. Quick commercial play I recommend to keep the deal simple while protecting margin:

1) HSM amortization: offer 6-month amortization (vs 12) but shift 25% to an implementation milestone (payable on install). This reduces billing friction for them and protects us if they churn. Example: $48k setup -> $12k milestone at install, remaining $36k over 6 months ($6k/mo).

2) HIPAA activation waiver at $150k ACV (instead of $200k). We make this concession up-front as a sales accelerator — tie it to signature within 45 days.

3) Add-on discount: 8% off listed add-on rates for 12-mo commit, 12% for 24-mo commit. Avoid unconditional 20% volume discounts unless they commit to minimums.

4) Pilot credit: offer $20k implementation credit for a 6–8 week pilot (applies to the implementation milestone).

5) SOC2 evidence: provide attestation PDF and a short QA session with our security SME. This is a low-cost ask that moves procurement.

If Lauren agrees, we can update the pricing workbook to show amortization schedule and a short clause for milestone payment. Also recommend adding a 30-day cancellation capture (pro-rated non-refundable on paid milestones).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Operations
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@carevault.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@carevault.com>, procurement@carevault.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: carevault compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency)

Lauren —

Thanks, and thanks Ben for the suggested structure. A few clarifying points from procurement/security: 

- SOC2: please send the Type II attestation PDF and the date range covered. Also include the most recent penetration test/ASV report or the summary of findings and remediation windows.
- HSM amortization: procurement prefers shorter capital exposure; can you do 6-month amortization but convert the install milestone to a per-hour setup cap instead (so we only pay for scoping + actual time)? If not, a 6-month amortization as Ben suggested is acceptable — we need the work breakdown so our finance team can sign-off.
- HIPAA waiver: $150k ACV is better than $200k — request to have the waiver tied to signature + PO within 30 days rather than 45.
- DocuSign / PO: please send a commercial summary or a DocuSign-ready SOW template with line items and your preferred payment terms (Net 45 or Net 60).

We have a tentative go/no-go on the pilot by 9/15. If terms are firmed and SOC2 evidence is acceptable, procurement can fast-track.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Samantha Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager, CareVault Health

Samantha — following up with an updated commercial summary based on your asks. See attached updated workbook (carevault_pricing_v4.xlsx) and SOC2 attestation PDF. Summary of changes: 

- HSM: 6-month amortization accepted. Install payment split: $12k install milestone (fixed), remainder amortized $6k/month for 6 months. We included a capped per-hour option in the appendix (up to 80 hours at $150/hr) if you prefer time-and-materials for final configuration.
- HIPAA activation waiver: reduced to $150k ACV and requires signed MSA + PO within 30 days of the quote.
- Add-on discounts: 8% for 12-month commit, 12% for 24-month commit (applies to audit log and KMS seat list prices).
- Pilot credit: $20k implementation credit applied against the install milestone.
- SOC2: attached SOC2_Type2_attestation.pdf (period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31). For pen-test/ASV we can share the high-level summary under an NDA; propose a 30-min technical call with our security SME next week.

DocuSign / next steps: I linked the HubSpot deal for your PO reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9312 and uploaded a DocuSign-ready SOW draft to our shared drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=carevault-sow-draft. If procurement confirms Net 45, finance will accept that; if you need Net 60 we can route for approval but prefer Net 45.

Thanks again — can we lock a time on Monday or Tuesday for a short SOW/implementation milestones call with Tom and your security lead? If you approve the commercial sheet I will send a DocuSign bundle with MSA + SOW + quote.

Best,
